meaning:
σαίνω
1. prop. (Hom., al.), of dogs, to wag the tail, fawn.
2. Metaphorical, of persons, with accusative, to fawn upon, flatter, beguile: pass., 1Th.3:3 (for conjectural emendations of the text, see ICC, and M, Th., in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
